notes:
RAG/search lead (VP ML, Alina Chen) very pragmatic: 'we can accept a small perf hit if precision improves for high-value queries' — BUT engineers are nervous about vector drift after reindex. Primary constraints: indexing scale (~250M embeddings), query latency SLO 150ms p50/p95 goal, production throughput ~300 qps peak. Current stack: in-house prefilter -> Faiss HNSW -> cross-encoder reranker (CPU batch) for top-50, cost ~ $0.003/query today. Objective: migrate to bi-encoder embeddings + lightweight transformer reranker to cut cost by ~50% while keeping MAP@10 within 2% of baseline.
- Eval-driven approach required: A/B test across labeled testsets (10k queries) + online canary with real traffic. Want Redwood Optimize to produce quantization + batching suggestions; need transparent token-cost breakdowns per route.
- Security: EU customer subset needs residency; legal requires audit logs + SSO (SAML) + KMS integration for keys at rest. Also retention controls for user-level logs (90 days) and ability to purge.
- "Important: show us rollback latency: if reranker degrades NDCG by >1.5% we must auto-roll back." — asked for automatable policies.
- Internal ask: provide estimated cost per query at 50 qps / 300 qps / 1k qps and compare hosted vs. dedicated vs. private (on-prem) TCO.
- POC metrics to watch: latency (p50/p95), MAP@10, NDCG@5, cost/query, CPU/GPU utilization during index/rollout.
Notes are fragmentary, may be repeated in next steps. Team comfortable with CLI + API but wants SDK examples and rollout playbook.
